newsitem.title: USA: LA Group negotiating secondary offering.
newsitem.headline: LA Group negotiating secondary offering.

text.p: LA Group Inc said Monday that it is negotiating with an undisclosed underwriter for a $30 million secondary offering of common stock.
The company said proceeds will be used to pay off debt, underwriting fees, provide working capital, and to develop the retail program for its As Seen on TV mall locations.
LA Group said it has seen a 30 percent increase in sales in the first two quarters of 1997.
This increase is largely due to the demand of exercise fitness equipment like the "Fitness Flyer and AB Roller Plus," the company said.
